Feeling worried you're getting left behind because AI isn't finding your website? Don't worry — the boat hasn't left yet.

There's a free, easy solution, and you don't need to rebuild anything. AI just needs quality answers to the questions its users ask, and it needs them current. So add new content to your site in the way AI needs it.
